# Contributing to Textify

Textify does not accept external pull requests at this time.

All contributions happen through GitHub Issues. Bug reports, feature requests,
and model suggestions are welcome when they follow the appropriate Issue Form.
Model suggestions are reviewed for license compatibility, quality, and product
fit; filing an issue does not guarantee inclusion or a timeline.

Pull requests opened against this repository are closed without review. Do not
submit model binaries through pull requests or issue attachments.

Report security vulnerabilities privately by following
[`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md). Do not put exploit details in a public issue.
